topic: What power management challenges arise from PD cell insertion losses versus PR cell cross-polarization filtering in dense networks?
response: In dense networks, PD cell insertion losses can lead to reduced signal strength and increased noise, whereas PR cell cross-polarization filtering may cause signal attenuation. Both effects can compromise network performance and require careful power management to mitigate.
